title: The Dream Archive - Theme
style: cinematic dream pop ballad, soft female vocals, music box, celesta, warm strings, ethereal choir, magical, emotional, English lyrics
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Hush now... close your eyes...)

[Verse 1]
When the night falls on the endless shelves
A thousand dreams sleep in jars of glass
One slipped away, left the door ajar
Leaving a trail of silver stars

[Chorus]
Dream archive, keep me safe
Don't let me forget your name
Chasing a dream that ran away
Maybe I'll find myself on the way

[Verse 2]
In every jar a child's first laugh
A paper kite, a summer sea
If I can't bring that dream back home
The morning skies will lose their glow

[Chorus]
Dream archive, keep me safe
Don't let me forget your name
Chasing a dream that ran away
Maybe I'll find myself on the way

[Bridge]
Close your eyes, don't be afraid
Every dream is a road, every road is hope

[Outro]
Dream archive... keep me safe...

Tick tock, stop the clock, stop!
Seven seconds mine, a single breath
I catch the falling leaf in the air
I'm the clockmaker's daughter, time's in my care

Tick... tock...
